analytics.raw_text: FIG. 1 is an X-ray powder diffraction diagram of form A. The conditions stated at this caption are the ones FIG. 2 and FIG. 3 adopt by reference.

notes: Tembotrione crystalline form A: the same molecule as tembotrione differing only in crystal lattice, not a distinct chemical entity. This section is the only place in the document that says which diffractogram belongs to which crystalline form: FIG. 1 form A, FIG. 2 form B, FIG. 3 form C. The diffractometer conditions are stated once, at the FIG. 1 caption, and adopted by reference by FIG. 2 and FIG. 3.
